_comment: TEMPLATE — not a real stage. Do not count this file as a Stage AREA-SPEC.
Copy this into docs/bsh/scenario/<sector>/<stage>/AREA-SPEC.json and fill in real,
reviewed values only. Every number/id below is a placeholder — do not treat it as
confirmed design data. See docs/bsh/scenario/AREA-SPEC-AUTHORING-STANDARD.md for the
full field-by-field contract, the known preset/system registry, and the reasons behind
each rule (local IDs, no world-global coordinates, no duplicated grapple data, etc.).
npm run validate:area-specs will NOT flag this file as a stage error, because it does
not live at docs/bsh/scenario/<sector>/<stage>/AREA-SPEC.json — but it also will not be
schema-checked for that reason. Validate your copy after renaming/relocating it.

surfaces._comment: preset must be a KNOWN Runtime surface kind, or declared under runtimeDependencies.newSystems.

grappleTargets._comment: One entry covers both the grapple-target surface AND the grapple-landmark object — do not author them twice.
grappleTargets.label: A

enemies._comment: Remove this entry entirely if the stage has no enemies (most Rest / Reveal stages don't).

scannerGroups._comment: controlledTargets must reference grappleTargets ids declared above. A target may belong to only one group.

route._comment: runtimeLandmarks = candidate authored routePoints. mandatory = must be clearable with swingImpulse=0. optional = flow/skill route. forbiddenBypasses = geometry that must NOT allow a progression skip.

exitBlock._comment: Only the minimal inputs exitBlock() needs — do not author deck/exit/panel/gate objects separately.

story._comment: planningTriggers = scenario-planning inventory only (mirrors defineArea().storyTriggers; the Assembler does not expose this as runtime state). runtimePresentations = story-display trigger-cue objects only; entry/objective/gate presentations are already implied by stage.areaId / objectives[].id / exitBlock.

runtimeDependencies._comment: Anything referenced above (preset/profile) that is not in the validator's known-preset registry MUST be declared here with status NOT_IMPLEMENTED, or validation fails.
